race.comment: BRISEIS ECLIPSE (7) had no luck when getting held up at a vital stage as the favourite at Strathalbyn 10 days ago before running on late for fifth over 1200m. The extra 350m is key, and with 2.5kg less to carry, she will be hard to hold out, so follow your money. WHISTLER GIRL (5) had been steadily building up her fitness levels and was back in the winner's circle at Coleraine 12 days ago over 1800m. The drop back to 1550m is the query for us, but she is normally so honest that she is worth including in all combos again. CRACKERJACK HATCH (6) has not been too far away in a couple of starts this prep, and she will don the blinkers for the first time. She cops another wide draw, but if she can stay handy, then she can bounce straight back into the money here. BLACK BUGATTI (11) is usually running on in his races, and he will have Rochelle Milnes in the saddle for the first time, and she can make a difference where it matters most.
